_readme: Shop the look. One entry per editorial photo. ALL LOOKS ARE PLACEHOLDERS until real photos exist.
Photo: put it at assets/lookbook/<handle>.jpg (portrait 4:5, 1600 x 2000 ideal). Until then a labelled slot is shown.
spots: one per garment worn. product = a handle from products.json. x / y = where the marker sits, in % of the photo
(0,0 is top left, 100,100 bottom right). Put it on the garment itself, roughly where you'd point.
Pieces from a drop that hasn't happened yet are left out automatically. The first look is featured on the homepage.
